reason: Verified by driving, not by eye. Measured in chromium at 1440, 1280, 768 and 390, the gap between .card.ages and its previous sibling is exactly 0 in every state that renders the strip: full and first-run (previous sibling .kpis), quiet (previous sibling the reassurance .card), and partial (previous sibling the .note). getComputedStyle(.ages).marginTop is 0px at all four widths; .band is a plain block with only padding-top, .kpis is a grid whose gap applies only between its own cells, and .ages carries no margin, so movementTwo()'s `${strip()}` concatenation does land flush. The code path matches: .band { padding-top: var(--gap-hall) } (l.194), .kpis (l.266) and .ages (l.289) carry no vertical margin. The rendered result is the KPI cards' 12px bottom corners sitting directly on the ages card's top hairline, with the two 1px borders stacked along the flat runs between the grid's 16px column gaps — the row reads as resting on a rule rather than as a separate object above a separate object. The seat is also right that this is an omission rather than a decision: the exactly analogous joint in movement three, the .limits grid followed by the full-width .ghost, is separated by margin-top: var(--gap-line) (l.337), as are .strip (l.290) and the partial-state .note (l.655). Movement two is the one band where that rung was never applied. Severity is correctly classed defect: nothing untrue is asserted, the shared-denominator contract and the honest-degradation contract are untouched, and the page still reads — it is visibly wrong and passable. It is not something either gate covers; audit.mjs checks palette, weights, contrast, hit targets, radii, motion and the type ramp, and interaction-check.mjs asserts behaviour, so neither can see a zero rung. Confirmed on the problem and the severity; the fix needs one branch removed, below.
sharpenedFix: Take only the second of the seat's two options: add `margin-top: var(--gap-line)` to .ages (l.289). Do NOT wrap movement two's contents in a flex column with gap — that branch is wrong twice over. .band-head already carries padding-bottom: var(--gap-line) (l.195), so a 16px flex gap would make the band-head-to-.kpis distance 32px in movement two while movements one and three keep 16px, breaking the header rhythm the page is otherwise consistent about; and in the partial state the .note already has an inline margin-top: var(--gap-line), which a flex gap would compound to 32px above the note and 16px below it, inverting the relationship. The margin on .ages is the one edit that fixes all three predecessors — .kpis, .note and the quiet reassurance card — in every state and at every width, with no case analysis. 16px is the right rung, not 24: it is exactly what .limits-to-.ghost uses for the same shape of joint (a card grid followed by a full-width object), so it keeps the ladder consistent rather than inventing a new step. Keep it at 16 in the narrow breakpoint too, matching .ghost, which does not step down. No separate quiet-state edit is needed — the quiet band renders the same strip() and inherits the margin.
breaks: Nothing structural: .ages is never a first child, so the new margin cannot collapse out of the band, and no state renders the strip without a preceding sibling. What it does break is every captured baseline. All content below the KPI row shifts down 16px in full, partial, quiet, first-run and loading (loading re-renders movementOne + movementTwo inside .sk-wrap, so the skeleton moves with it, which is correct — the skeleton must keep matching the real geometry it promises). Re-capture all ten frames listed in the brief, plus the dark variants, and re-run both gates: audit.mjs for radii and hit targets (position-insensitive but cheap), and interaction-check.mjs because the dot tooltips and any scroll- or focus-position assertions in movement two are now 16px lower. Re-measure specifically: the ages card's top at 1440 full moves 950.2 to 966.2; check at 390 that the extra 16px does not push the coverage footer or movement three past any fold assertion; and confirm the .rise entrance on the ages card (--i:3) still lands with the card starting 10px lower rather than overlapping the KPI row mid-animation.
